title: Two-Component Gain-Integrator Co-Simulation
description: Minimal SSP 1.0 co-simulation architecture wiring a scalar gain FMU into an integrator FMU with external SSV parameter values and FMI model descriptions.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ssd:SystemStructureDescription xmlns:ssd="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription"
                                xmlns:ssc="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureCommon"
                                name="GainIntegratorCoSim"
                                version="1.0"
                                description="Two-component scalar gain and integrator co-simulation">
  <ssd:System name="GainIntegratorSystem">
    <ssd:Connectors>
      <ssd:Connector name="u_in" kind="input">
        <ssc:Real />
      </ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="y_out" kind="output">
        <ssc:Real />
      </ssd:Connector>
    </ssd:Connectors>
    <ssd:ParameterBindings>
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="params.ssv" />
    </ssd:ParameterBindings>
    <ssd:Elements>
      <ssd:Component name="GainBlock" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Gain">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="u" kind="input"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="y" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="k" kind="parameter"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="IntegratorBlock" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Integrator">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="u" kind="input"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="y" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="y0" kind="parameter"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
    </ssd:Elements>
    <ssd:Connections>
      <ssd:Connection startElement="GainIntegratorSystem" startConnector="u_in" endElement="GainBlock" endConnector="u" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="GainBlock" startConnector="y" endElement="IntegratorBlock" endConnector="u" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="IntegratorBlock" startConnector="y" endElement="GainIntegratorSystem" endConnector="y_out" />
    </ssd:Connections>
  </ssd:System>
  <ssd:DefaultExperiment startTime="0.0" stopTime="10.0" />
</ssd:SystemStructureDescription>

title: Quarter-Car Suspension Co-Simulation
description: Automotive quarter-car ride dynamics co-simulation coupling a road profile generator FMU and a two-mass suspension FMU with SSV parameters and SSM mapping.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ssd:SystemStructureDescription xmlns:ssd="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription"
                                xmlns:ssc="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureCommon"
                                name="QuarterCarSuspension"
                                version="1.0"
                                description="Quarter-car vertical ride dynamics co-simulation">
  <ssd:System name="QuarterCar">
    <ssd:Connectors>
      <ssd:Connector name="body_accel" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="m/s2" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="body_disp" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="m" /></ssd:Connector>
    </ssd:Connectors>
    <ssd:ParameterBindings>
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="chassis.ssv" />
    </ssd:ParameterBindings>
    <ssd:Elements>
      <ssd:Component name="RoadProfile" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Road">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="z_road" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="m" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="SuspensionPlant" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Suspension">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="z_road" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="m" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="a_sprung" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="m/s2" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="z_sprung" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="m" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
    </ssd:Elements>
    <ssd:Connections>
      <ssd:Connection startElement="RoadProfile" startConnector="z_road" endElement="SuspensionPlant" endConnector="z_road" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="SuspensionPlant" startConnector="a_sprung" endElement="QuarterCar" endConnector="body_accel" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="SuspensionPlant" startConnector="z_sprung" endElement="QuarterCar" endConnector="body_disp" />
    </ssd:Connections>
  </ssd:System>
  <ssd:DefaultExperiment startTime="0.0" stopTime="5.0" />
</ssd:SystemStructureDescription>

title: Closed-Loop HVAC Thermal Zone & Controller
description: Building thermal zone co-simulation connecting a room thermal envelope FMU and a PI thermostat controller FMU in a closed feedback loop.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ssd:SystemStructureDescription xmlns:ssd="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription"
                                xmlns:ssc="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureCommon"
                                name="HvacZoneLoop"
                                version="1.0"
                                description="Closed-loop HVAC thermal zone and thermostat controller">
  <ssd:System name="HvacSystem">
    <ssd:Connectors>
      <ssd:Connector name="T_setpoint" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="K" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="T_room" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="K" /></ssd:Connector>
    </ssd:Connectors>
    <ssd:ParameterBindings>
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="hvac.ssv" />
    </ssd:ParameterBindings>
    <ssd:Elements>
      <ssd:Component name="Controller" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/controller_modelDescription.xml">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="T_ref" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="K" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="T_meas" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="K" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="Q_cmd" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="W" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="ThermalZone" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/zone_modelDescription.xml">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="Q_hvac" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="W" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="T_zone" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="K" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
    </ssd:Elements>
    <ssd:Connections>
      <ssd:Connection startElement="HvacSystem" startConnector="T_setpoint" endElement="Controller" endConnector="T_ref" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="Controller" startConnector="Q_cmd" endElement="ThermalZone" endConnector="Q_hvac" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="ThermalZone" startConnector="T_zone" endElement="Controller" endConnector="T_meas" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="ThermalZone" startConnector="T_zone" endElement="HvacSystem" endConnector="T_room" />
    </ssd:Connections>
  </ssd:System>
  <ssd:DefaultExperiment startTime="0.0" stopTime="7200.0" />
</ssd:SystemStructureDescription>

title: Hybrid EV Powertrain Multi-FMU Co-Simulation
description: Electric vehicle traction powertrain co-simulation linking battery pack, traction inverter, and PMSM motor FMUs with separate SSV parameter files and SSM signal mapping.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ssd:SystemStructureDescription xmlns:ssd="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription"
                                xmlns:ssc="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureCommon"
                                name="EvPowertrainCoSim"
                                version="1.0"
                                description="800V EV battery, traction inverter, and PMSM motor co-simulation">
  <ssd:System name="EvPowertrain">
    <ssd:Connectors>
      <ssd:Connector name="torque_cmd" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="N.m" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="shaft_torque" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="N.m" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="soc" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
    </ssd:Connectors>
    <ssd:ParameterBindings>
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="battery.ssv" />
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="inverter.ssv" />
    </ssd:ParameterBindings>
    <ssd:Elements>
      <ssd:Component name="BatteryPack" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Battery">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="i_dc" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="A" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="v_dc" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="V" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="soc" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="TractionInverter" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Inverter">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="v_dc" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="V" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="tau_ref" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="N.m" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="i_dc" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="A" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="i_q" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="A" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="PmsmMotor" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/Motor">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="i_q" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="A" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="tau_out" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="N.m" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
    </ssd:Elements>
    <ssd:Connections>
      <ssd:Connection startElement="EvPowertrain" startConnector="torque_cmd" endElement="TractionInverter" endConnector="tau_ref" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="BatteryPack" startConnector="v_dc" endElement="TractionInverter" endConnector="v_dc" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="TractionInverter" startConnector="i_dc" endElement="BatteryPack" endConnector="i_dc" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="TractionInverter" startConnector="i_q" endElement="PmsmMotor" endConnector="i_q" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="PmsmMotor" startConnector="tau_out" endElement="EvPowertrain" endConnector="shaft_torque" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="BatteryPack" startConnector="soc" endElement="EvPowertrain" endConnector="soc" />
    </ssd:Connections>
  </ssd:System>
  <ssd:DefaultExperiment startTime="0.0" stopTime="1800.0" />
</ssd:SystemStructureDescription>

title: Microgrid Multi-FMU Plant & Relay Protection
description: Full multi-FMU islandable microgrid co-simulation integrating BESS grid-forming inverter, utility feeder grid model, SSV parameter sets, SSM relay mappings, and FMI descriptors.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ssd:SystemStructureDescription xmlns:ssd="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription"
                                xmlns:ssc="http://ssp-standard.org/SSP1/SystemStructureCommon"
                                name="MicrogridPlantCoSim"
                                version="1.0"
                                description="Islandable microgrid with BESS grid-forming inverter and feeder model">
  <ssd:System name="MicrogridPlant">
    <ssd:Connectors>
      <ssd:Connector name="p_load_kw" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="kW" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="f_ref_hz" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="Hz" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="v_ref_pu" kind="input"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="f_bus_hz" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="Hz" /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="v_bus_pu" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
      <ssd:Connector name="island_mode" kind="output"><ssc:Boolean /></ssd:Connector>
    </ssd:Connectors>
    <ssd:ParameterBindings>
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="grid.ssv" />
      <ssd:ParameterBinding source="bess.ssv" />
    </ssd:ParameterBindings>
    <ssd:Elements>
      <ssd:Component name="BessInverter" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/bess_modelDescription.xml">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="f_meas" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="Hz" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="v_meas" kind="input"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="p_bess_kw" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="kW" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="q_bess_kvar" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="kvar" /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
      <ssd:Component name="GridFeeder" type="application/x-fmu-sharedlibrary" source="resources/grid_modelDescription.xml">
        <ssd:Connectors>
          <ssd:Connector name="p_load_kw" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="kW" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="p_bess_kw" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="kW" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="q_bess_kvar" kind="input"><ssc:Real unit="kvar" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="f_bus_hz" kind="output"><ssc:Real unit="Hz" /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="v_bus_pu" kind="output"><ssc:Real /></ssd:Connector>
          <ssd:Connector name="breaker_open" kind="output"><ssc:Boolean /></ssd:Connector>
        </ssd:Connectors>
      </ssd:Component>
    </ssd:Elements>
    <ssd:Connections>
      <ssd:Connection startElement="MicrogridPlant" startConnector="p_load_kw" endElement="GridFeeder" endConnector="p_load_kw" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="MicrogridPlant" startConnector="f_ref_hz" endElement="BessInverter" endConnector="f_meas" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="MicrogridPlant" startConnector="v_ref_pu" endElement="BessInverter" endConnector="v_meas" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="BessInverter" startConnector="p_bess_kw" endElement="GridFeeder" endConnector="p_bess_kw" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="BessInverter" startConnector="q_bess_kvar" endElement="GridFeeder" endConnector="q_bess_kvar" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="GridFeeder" startConnector="f_bus_hz" endElement="MicrogridPlant" endConnector="f_bus_hz" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="GridFeeder" startConnector="v_bus_pu" endElement="MicrogridPlant" endConnector="v_bus_pu" />
      <ssd:Connection startElement="GridFeeder" startConnector="breaker_open" endElement="MicrogridPlant" endConnector="island_mode" />
    </ssd:Connections>
  </ssd:System>
  <ssd:DefaultExperiment startTime="0.0" stopTime="60.0" />
</ssd:SystemStructureDescription>
